bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's website, about 60 days ahead, a week at a time: new dates are released every Sunday at 11am Mountain Time. Booking requires a deposit, refunded on arrival. There are two main seatings a night, so few tables are offered between 6:30pm and 7pm.
cancellation: Cancel more than 48 hours ahead for a full refund of the deposit; within 48 hours the booking can be moved to another night (if available) and the deposit transferred. Arriving more than 15 minutes late may mean missing part of the meal.
walkIns: Bar seats can be booked as well as dining-room tables, with either menu chosen on arrival.
groups: Tables seat up to eight; larger parties go through events@frascafoodandwine.com. The private Taverna Room seats 26 and the whole restaurant up to 70.
dressCode: No formal dress code, but most guests dress up, as it is a special-occasion restaurant.
children: Children are welcome; count them in the booking and ask the reservations team for a high chair.
byob: No corkage: Colorado law does not allow it.

bookingWindow.note: A new week is released each Sunday at 11am Mountain Time, about 60 days ahead.
